scope: Exploratory working checkout. Earlier runs are superseded by clean source-bound qualification, never erased or counted as passes.
observations: An incorrectly prefixed CMake target was refused before compilation; the actual target was used.
Strict producer validation exposed a missing plan_digest property and a semantic helper reading case failure_domain at the wrong nesting level; both were corrected.

A mutated capture epoch exposed missing separate request/state binding in shared replies. Native retained-header bindings are now reported separately and compared, with strict producer semantics and regressions.

The retention-fault test incorrectly expected an unknown observation request. The pre-authored contract says a completed read may report an unknown logical disposition. The harness now asserts both separate facts and still requires unknown execution with no restart.

The full working tool suite recorded one stale generated-index failure during documentation edits. Generated freshness was restored before freezing the source; clean qualification reran the complete suite.

The clean runner stopped after 74 passed native groups and the passed focused suite because its broad prefix predicate counted 126 instead of 63 bit cases. The predicate was corrected and remaining qualification resumed against the same unchanged clean native checkout; original failure and resumed outputs stay retained.
All four failed generated fixture directories remain retained. Native owners were observed before cleanup would be allowed; none was deleted to hide a failure.
